newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Champion Tech details spin off plan.
newsitem.headline: Champion Tech details spin off plan.

text.p: Champion Technology Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to distribute a total of 159.17 million shares of its proposed spin-off unit Kantone Holdings Ltd as a special interim dividend to Champion shareholders.

The distributed Kantone shares, representing about 43 percent of the unit's issued capital, would be allocated on the basis of one-for-10 Champion shares held, the telepaging group said in a statement.
Kantone is mainly involved in the design, manufacture and distribution of radio telcommunications systems and equipment with production facilities in the U.K. and Malaysia.

After completion of the spin-off, Champion president Paul Kan and his associates will hold 17.56 percent of Kantone while Champion's interest in the unit will be decreased to about 57 percent from 100 percent, the company said.
The remaining 25.44 percent will be owned by shareholders other than Kan and his associates, whose stake in Champion totalled about 40.84 percent.
It is expected the spin-off proposal will be completed on or before January 17, 1997, and dealing in Kantone shares is expected to start on January 23, 1997.
